notes.title: ONLY TOGETHER WE CAN WIN!
notes.content:
[b]Another major update with tons of new features. Fixed old bugs, added new ones in order to fix them later. Added a music player to the collection menu and, most importantly, co-op missions. [/b]

[u]Bugs:[/u] Something was broken, something was fixed, nothing interesting.

[u]New features:[/u]
1. Finally, chat has been added to multiplayer. On the third try I even managed to make it work.
2. The music player will allow you to enjoy the magnificent music accompaniment of Norr: Ace Shot right in the main menu, each composition of which has been selected with special love for the players.
3. Co-op has been added! If you have friends, then you can go through three cooperative missions with them [strike] and lose them [/ strike]. Currently available:
    1. Arena. Endless hordes of enemies, each of which poses a huge danger to
    loners. Only together you can win!
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/35152495b28533fc55b22fa41d5cc341bb125232.png[/img]
    2. Challenge the Miami police and rob the biggest bank in the city!
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/03438a6a366779db9fe56b59bb2ae80c06e234f5.png[/img]
    3. 4 ways. To get out of here, each of you will have to show your maximum!
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/bab81249d57475a6c0f1357269ee4ab4ea087a54.png[/img]

[u]Visual improvements:[/u]
Now, when an NPC or player dies, a blood trail will appear in his place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/151b26f9647c907d154f468b18d3c7453ff283d6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fix pack #3
notes.content:
In this version:
1. Minor interface fixes.
2. Fixed a reloading bug.
3. Added the ability to stun enemies.
4. Minor sound fixes.
5. Visual interface improvements.
6. Improved AI (bots have become more aggressive).
7. Fixed bug with infinite time slow in chapter 9 and in the survival mode.
8. Doors've been reworked. Doors now have physical properties.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/fa3f84f511e2e9247193e3b20f84c1d69c33244f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/bcd5f4cc28ec5a0e5f21c3f7fbf039ac9d5cf44d.png[/img]

notes.title: Fix pack #2
notes.content:
In this version:
1. If you skip the intro and credits, the music stops playing.
2. Fixed a bug due to which the ability to slow time disappeared when restarting chapter 8.
3. Fixed the invisibility of fog in the first chapter.
4. Chapter 9 has been reworked.
5. Added sound effects when starting the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/ea0fe6f32b1132a30fe0c39f13dc71dd7c625446.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fix pack #1
notes.content:
In this version:
1. Objectives change dynamically at some levels.
2. Added kill effect (can be disabled in settings menu).
3. Chapters 1, 6, 7 and 8 have been redone.
4. Minor interface fixes.
5. Replacement of some models.
6. Now cut-scenes will be automatically skipped when restarting the level (this function can be disabled in the settings menu).
7. Unfortunately, the 32-bit version of the game is no longer available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/26c3a734fb783080744306b2c04801a6debef16a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE: MULTIPLAYER AND EVENTS!
notes.content:
[h1]Our team is glad to introduce you new online features![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/1b5258d9618f98831d192962e71baa113746bf25.png[/img]

[b]MULTIPLAYER UPDATE[/b]

[i]We are pleased to inform you that from now multiplayer will be available in the game!
It will be expanded and maintained in the future. Stay with us![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/7afcaeaf72d291912ecbf9a76a08ac32248fd1fb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/f806111b28548123136ca6ef5bfed4e4fb6eb82f.png[/img]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/7a1567c3b8cd568e707417405254f111cc7bf0ab.png[/img]

[b]EVENTS UPDATE[/b]

[i]Our team is pleased to present you a new game mechanics! Events!
Special levels available for passing only in certain seasons.
Did you find the story mode and survival too simple?
Then events are exactly what you need![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/b014d7e92c0aef0918948acdc824be4816835bc2.png[/img]
